[IARC.7.10] **CORE-MATH is vendored.** libds compiles the correctly-rounded
functions [LEXP.3.9.2] requires from CORE-MATH's binary64 sources at one pinned
upstream commit, through the same pinned-fetch path as RE2, with the files
unmodified. They are compiled with libds's flags (`-O2 -ffp-contract=off`, and
`-std=gnu11` for the 128-bit integer types) on a toolchain whose
`FLT_EVAL_METHOD` is 0. The pin and the flags are recorded together: a change to
either changes the functions, and a release row built with it is admitted again
before it ships ([NDET.1.4]).
